headline: Choice International acquires 100% stake in Choice Proptech Solutions
sum: Choice International Limited announced acquisition of 100% stake in Choice Proptech Solutions Private Limited. The transaction was disclosed via NSE filing as a general corporate update.
implication: Vertical integration of technology infrastructure into hospitality operations; review whether this triggers mandatory disclosure under Listing Rules 2015 (related party or material acquisition thresholds) and whether Choice Proptech Solutions constitutes a 'related party' under Ind AS 24.
detail: Choice International Limited, a hospitality company listed on NSE, announced the acquisition of full equity ownership of Choice Proptech Solutions Private Limited. The announcement was made via NSE Corporate Announcements portal on 20 August 2026. No consideration amount, deal structure, conditions precedent, or completion status were disclosed in the headline filing. The acquisition appears to be a strategic integration of technology capabilities into the parent company's hotel operations.
